node.title: PROVED (X-8 task 2): exact polynomial toral components give power-pullback only
node.statement: char K = 0 or > deg psi: if psi(X) - psi(Y) has a non-diagonal toral component in (G_m)^2, the component is X = lambda Y and psi = phi(X^m) (m = ord(lambda) > 1) after scaling — the monomial case ONLY. Proof: sign/degree bookkeeping kills X^A Y^B = c (positive exponents vs negative); X^A = c Y^B forces A = B = 1; psi(lambda Y) = psi(Y) forces lambda^i = 1 on all exponents. Verified here (elementary). CONSEQUENCE: Dickson/Chebyshev does NOT arise from polynomial toral components — it needs Laurent/rational psi, so T's Laurent case is load-bearing, not decorative.
node.notes: X-8 deliverable; quotient-row stable.
